mainEntity.name: How much does dry rot repair cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of dry rot repair varies significantly depending on the extent of the damage, the type of wood affected, and the accessibility of the area. Minor repairs might range from a few hundred dollars, while extensive structural dry rot requiring significant timber replacement could run into several thousands. Given the varying property types and construction in the Alameda and Berkeley areas, a detailed on-site inspection is essential to provide an accurate estimate for your specific situation. This allows for a precise assessment of materials and labor needed.
